highlights_headline: Modern .NET UWP apps gain CPU and ANGLE-backed GPU drawing controls for the in-box Windows XAML stack.
highlights_body: The new UWP integration targets .NET 10 and remains separate from WinUI. It does not restore legacy uap10.0 support.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.UWP targets net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0 with a declared Windows minimum of 10.0.17763.0. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies ANGLE and native integration for win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64, reusing the core Win32 Skia and HarfBuzz binaries. This is not legacy uap10.0 support or a Store-certification claim.

Use SKXamlCanvas for CPU drawing and SKSwapChainPanel for ANGLE-backed GPU drawing in SkiaSharp.Views.UWP. PaintSurface callbacks receive control-managed surfaces: CPU surfaces are disposed after the callback, while GPU resources are released when the context is destroyed. The documented sample workflow requires Visual Studio 2026 MSBuild and deployment.

contributor_summaries.FoggyFinder: Modern .NET UWP drawing controls, native integration and packaged samples.
